name: Area 53 Game
author: mehmetyusufbilge
description: WASD for Movement,                                                                                                    E for Special Ability,                                                                                     SPACE for Jumping,                                                                                               F for Frozing Time,                                                                                       Please play in full screen. The aim of the game is to find the white/yellow cube by navigating the maze. Click "Clear Choices" from the OPTIONS section to reset your character. Click "Delete Saves" to start the game from the beginning.
